notes.title: Update since full released
notes.content:
We have been committed to improving the content of the game since full released. Here are the details:
1.Fixed the DLC function.
2.Adjust the skill power, it is more reasonable now.
3.Fix a bug in the Training Camp.
4. Adjusted attribute growth of each role to improve survivability.
5. Adjusted the enemy's attributes to make them more challenging.
6. Adjusted the level rewards to make them more appropriate.
7. Fullscreen function has been added (F11 is the default hotkey, it is also in the options menu).
8. Steam's F12 and Shift+Tab shortcut keys have been fully integrated, you can upload screenshots!
9.Fixed a bug that some professional guards could not recruit.
10. Adjusted the random rank of guards when they were hired .
11. Fixed DLC usage problem
12. Fixed an important bug: after receiving the task (main line or branch line), go to the training camp to pass the customs can directly complete the task.
13. Fixed the problem that the database was stolen and affected the second-times playing.
14. Optimize the skill interface and inform the occupations that skills can be used.
15. Fixed the bug that Ling long's skill of recovery completely freezes the game(unplayable) when used .(thanks for the information provided by Nameless)
16. Adjusted the rewards of training camps
17. Fixed the bug of the Training Camp.
18. Fixed the bug that orientated learning skills could not open the interface.
19. Fixed the bug that the coupon did not refresh in time when the coupon was 0.
20. Fixed bug that guard's status did not recover after reading archive when guard was injured in battle.
21.Adjusted some skills effect.
22. Optimized some stories' scene;
23. Adjusted the status of some enemies to make them more challenging.
24. Optimized the display of blood volume in combat animation scene;
25. Accelerated the speed of animation performance;
26. The game display name (upper left corner) is TSM2.
27. When the skills have reached their max level, the "yes" button will not appear when the directional learning interface is opened again.
28. Added the quick undo function of the right mouse button in the combat operation;
29. Adjusted the effect of passive skill "Horse’s Endurance" and "accumulate" .

So,I hope you can enjoy our game as well, and help me to review it.

notes.title: Announcement of Update V 0.6.10 for 《Princess of Holy Light》
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your inclusiveness and support, and for giving us feedback in a timely manner. At present, our development team has updated the version to V0.6.10. The main changes are as follows:

1. Modified the bug that the attributes of blacksmith's weapons are not displayed
2. Modify the bugs that show 100 times less avoidance and hit rates in the pub interface
3. Modify the bugs that show 100 times less critical strike rate, hit rate and avoidance rate in the transfer interface
4. The plot dialogue optimizes the characters'performance and adds shadows.
5. The coefficients of some skills have been revised to make them more reasonable and useful.
6. The judgment of skill learning is optimized. If the skills are randomized to the full level, they will continue to be randomized.
7. Fixed bugs in plot presentation
8. Optimized the problem of not showing the attributes in time when replacing equipment.
9. A bug with the same skills will be added when new roles are fixed
10. Fixed a bug that would stuck when it was released beyond the screen.
11. Fixed bugs that debuff won't automatically disappear after Hellfire
12. Optimizing the tripartite display in battle, we, our friends and enemies have added angle marks to make it clear.

notes.title: Announcement of Update V0.2.1 for 《Princess of Holy Light》

tags.balance_change: 1. Adjust the resources acquired from the main line task, including: the number of skill books, sap, and winning funds;
2. Adjust the difficulty of the main line task;
3. Adjust the difficulty of the monster of the branch task;
4. Adjusting the growth attributes of the characters;
5. Adjusted the role level upper limit, the current level cap is 99;

tags.bug: 6. Fixed an error that the window could not be closed when the guard and character skills were viewed;
7. Fixed an error that occurred during the guard operation;
8. Fixed some other known bugs;

tags.feature:
9.The transfer system has been added. Currently, there are 28 occupations in the game. When the current occupation reaches a certain level, the transfer will be started. The current transferable level and the maximum level are as follows:
1st stage occupation: 30 (transferable) / 50 (maximum level)
2nd stage occupation: 50 (transferable) / 70 (maximum level)
3rd stage occupation: 90 (maximum level)
10. The new transfer building - the Transfer Temple, when the role reaches the transfer conditions, it will appear in the temple interface;
11. Added two professional skills. After the transfer, everyone has more skills and combinations to facilitate the creation of their own unique heroes;
12. Optimized some of the interfaces (continuous optimization will continue in the future).

notes.title: 《POHL》new version:V0.1.1 update notice
notes.content:
Thank you for your inclusiveness and support. At present, our development team has updated the version to V0.1.1. The main contents of this update are as follows:

1, adjusted the initial value of the roles.

2, adjusted the growth of the roles.

3, adjusting the attributes of weapons;

4. We have adjusted the synthetic formula of weapons.

5. A new game feature system has been added: guard, each character can take a guard of the same profession, making the battle more diverse;

6, a new training camp system has been added, which can be used to train escorts and obtain a large number of "SAP bottles".



If you have any questions about the above content, please tell me in the discuss board.

At the same time, we will add the following contents in next week's version update:

1, upgrade system: now has designed 28 occupations, each occupation will have different attribute ability;

2, the temple of transfer is open to the public and can be transferred to trial here.

3, add some vocational skills, increase about 10 or more new skills so that you can choose combinations.



I hope you will continue to support our game, if you think it's good, please recommend the game to your friends, we will be very appreciated!

notes.title: POHL November 9th update notice
notes.content:
This update mainly implements "guard" system. With the addition of guard, battles will become more diverse. At present, each character can carry one guard. The guard will randomly bring one active and one passive skill.

In the next update, we will introduce the "Upgrade System". At present, 28 professions have been developed, and each role will have two "choices" at each upgrade. More content, please pay attention to official announcement.

notes.title: A letter to everyone on the release date
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your attention to 《Princess of Holy Light》! On behalf of the development team, I would like to express my sincere gratitude to all players.
Since the project is still in the Early Access stage, if you find bugs, please let us know through the in-game settings -bug report, or you can inform us via the steam forums . This is also our first time in Early Access. If you have any suggestions, you can also give us feedback through the above channels.

In addition, we have also developed a reward plan:
Cumulative sales hits 5,000:
All players recieve full-size CG files
Cumulative sales hits 20,000:
A new girl will be created, based on the players' requests, and will be launched as free DLC.
Cumulative sales hits 50,000:
We will create a Cosplay Album of the girls (of the currently released girls) and each player will be able to select one girls' pictures to recieve for free. The rest will be available as a DLC.

About the game's production plan:
First stage of Early Access
1. Add active and passive skills for each occupation in the base game.
2. Regularly add new tasks, especially high-level ones, and increase the player level cap.
3. Improve the game's systems and adjust the player experience.

Second stage of Early Access:
1. Implement real-time, scheduled missions and launch new characters
2.According to player feedback, production and launch of new game systems.
3. Add CGs.

Last stage of Early Access:
1. Add DLC pack for Cosplay.
2. Increase the sub-command system.

I hope everyone can support and help us!
